cut_rhythm.pattern: two scenes: 0-10.12 s speed-check bars, 10.12-34.01 s long evolving explainer with dissolve in; mid-scene icon scenes change every ~2.5-3 s through in-scene animation

shots.composition: one hero object centred in upper-middle (bars, router card, laptop, donut, panel), caption below, footer row at bottom

elements.easing: spring with soft overshoot; stamp CAUGHT with scale-down slam

text.role: karaoke captions plus on-object UI labels
text.position: captions at about 68 percent frame height; wordmark top; handles bottom
text.animation_in: words blur-in one by one, key phrase highlight in green (double)

grade.look: bright off-white UI with warm orange-red accent and soft mint glow

layout.safe_zones: wordmark top, hero object upper-middle, captions lower-middle, footer handles bottom
layout.framing_notes: same footer handles (heysansser, sansser, /sansser.com) fixed across the whole reel

recipe.notes: one illustrated scene per narrated sentence: wifi card with CAUGHT stamp, bars 300 vs 202 Mbps, router suspect card with magnifier, laptop terminal radar, donut 6 percent eaten, wifi channel bell curve, Found 3 fixes dialog with cursor, speed jump 151 Mbps, 2x badge, router end card; spring values estimated

evidence.claim: hook card: wifi 148 Mbps with red CAUGHT stamp, caption red-handed
two bars Your plan 300 Mbps grey vs You get 202 Mbps orange, caption You pay for one
Found 3 fixes dialog with checkboxes Pause background uploads, Switch to 5 GHz, Move router to channel 11; cursor moves to Yes fix it
2x the speed badge, caption People are getting double the speed with double highlighted green

notes: Scene count and dissolve are measured; the many sub-scenes (e1-e13 in the events collage at 3.3, 4.2, 7.7, 12.0, 14.8, 17.5, 20.5, 22.8, 25.0, 28.7 s) are in-scene animation, read from collages.
